comment: A steel buckler, 0.32 m across, gripped in the fist behind a deep boss. It covers a hand's width and no more: it is a thing you put where the blade is going, not a wall to stand behind. Regenerate with scripts/gen_shield_items.py; the hilt box is emitted from the same constants that build the mesh, so the fist cannot drift off the grip.
name: buckler
